text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`. This ensures keyboard users see a clear, high-contrast target on all devices, including touchscreens where fat fingers need space. The trade-off is slightly larger rings on reduced-motion systems, but that’s acceptable because visibility trumps minimalism for accessibility.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 4px at 7:1 fails users toggling *both* reduced motion *and* high contrast—WCAG 2.2 requires 3px at 4.5:1 for those users. Better alternative: use 3px at 4.5:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and 4px at 7:1 otherwise. Settle with a live keyboard nav test on a high-contrast, reduced-motion device.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px focus ring at 4.5:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`, and 4px at 7:1 otherwise. This covers the widest user base—keyboard navigators, high-contrast users, and those with reduced motion—without locking anyone out. The trade-off is slightly smaller rings on standard systems, but clarity and compliance outweigh marginal visual weight.

name: Reader
text: Risk: 3px at 4.5:1 fails users who *only* toggle high contrast mode—WCAG 2.2 requires 3px at 4.5:1 *or* 4px at 7:1. Better alternative: use 4px at 7:1 with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and 3px at 4.5:1 *only* when `forced-colors: active`. Settle with a live keyboard nav test on a high-contrast, reduced-motion system.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Use 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast with `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference` and 3px at 4.5:1 only when `forced-colors: active`. Result: WCAG-compliant focus rings for all users. Owner: accessibility-w1.
